about: Renders a column of headings. Each heading contains a trigger that shows and hides the content under it. One item is open at a time unless `multiple` is set, and the arrow keys move focus between the triggers.

checkout.about: The caller controls `value` and opens the next section from a button. Each later section is disabled until the reader continues to it, and the arrow keys skip it.
checkout.placed: Order placed. A receipt is on its way.
checkout.title: Controlled

liability.body: Each party's liability is capped at the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.
liability.title: Liability

payment.body: Invoices are due 30 days after the invoice date, by bank transfer to the account on the invoice.
payment.title: Payment

scope.body: Covers the platform, its API and the support desk in every region the order form lists.
scope.title: Scope

disabled.about: With `disabled` on the root, no trigger opens its item or takes focus. `disabled` on an item disables that item alone, as the controlled scene shows.
disabled.title: Disabled

documents.about: A button after the trigger renders at the end of the heading and outside the trigger, so it has a tab stop of its own and a press on it leaves the item as it is.

contract.body: Signed on 3 March by both parties. It renews each year unless either party gives 60 days' notice.
contract.title: Service agreement

invoice.body: €4,800.00, paid on 12 March by bank transfer.
invoice.title: Invoice INV-2041

nda.body: Covers the pilot and the two years after it ends.
nda.title: Mutual NDA

documents.title: Actions

abroad.answer: We ship to 34 countries. Duties are paid at checkout, so nothing is due on delivery.
abroad.question: Do you ship outside the country?

delivery.answer: Orders placed before two in the afternoon ship the same day and arrive in one to three working days.
delivery.question: How long does delivery take?

returns.answer: Return any unworn item within 30 days. The label is in the parcel, and the refund is on your card within five working days of the item arriving back.
returns.question: Can I return an order?

icons.about: An icon before the title renders one size smaller than the indicator, and the indicators line up in one column at the end of every trigger.
icons.title: Icons

motion.about: Every motion: the content slides, fades or appears at once. Press a trigger to see it.
motion.title: Motion

multiple.about: With `multiple`, opening an item leaves the others open. A filter panel keeps each group of choices open while the reader compares them.
multiple.title: Several open

palette.about: Every palette in the subtle look, which fills the open item and a trigger under the pointer from the palette.
palette.title: Palettes

reviewers.about: An avatar and a second line in the trigger show whose item it is before it is opened. The avatar is hidden from assistive technology, because the name follows it in words.

ada.name: Ada Okafor
ada.note: Approved the scope and the payment terms.

iris.name: Iris Hale
iris.note: Approved. The data clause matches the security policy.

reviewers.title: Avatars

tomas.name: Tomas Beck
tomas.note: Asks for payment 45 days after the invoice date instead of 30.

size.about: Every size. The size sets the trigger's height and text, the indicator, and the body's padding and text.
size.title: Sizes

title: Accordion

variant.about: Every look, with the first question open. Subtle fills the open item from the palette. Surface and outline render a box with a hairline between items. Flushed rules a hairline under each item, and plain renders no line.
variant.title: Looks
